articles.title: A tiny payment can expose the IP address behind a bitcoin wallet, developer finds
articles.snippet: A Bitcoin Core contributor found that the wallet's habit of resending stuck payments lets anyone link an address to the computer watching it, for under 35 cents.

articles.title: Binance completes withdrawal recovery four weeks after $6.3B hack
articles.snippet: The announcement concludes a phased withdrawal recovery that began on Nov. 1, when Binance restored Bitcoin withdrawals following the record crypto theft.

articles.title: Spain moves to grant financial watchdog power to freeze crypto accounts
articles.snippet: A new decree would allow Spain’s financial intelligence unit to suspend crypto accounts, with firms facing fines for noncompliance.

articles.title: Standard Chartered’s Zodia Custody suffers data breach
articles.snippet: Zodia Custody’s CEO said the breach exposed names and email addresses of some clients and employees and was detected by the company Monday.

articles.title: Could AI Break Bitcoin? Not Yet, Research Firm K33 Says
articles.snippet: A draft AI-assisted proof of the Riemann Hypothesis renewed worries about the math securing Bitcoin, but K33 says no cryptographic compromise has been demonstrated.
